description: public.tiff from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened /private/tmp/rclip-capture/bands.png (24x16 truecolour PNG, three vertical colour bands, written by hand with zlib), then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: Big-endian TIFF ('MM'), 24x16 RGB, 16 IFD entries. 4556 bytes for 384 pixels because tag 0x8773 carries a 3144-byte ICC profile.
